statements.t: Management is anticipating the possibility that our contractual arrangements with TelevisaUnivision will terminate after the initial extension period ends on March 31, 2027 and is beginning to explore alternatives, which may include the disposition of our television assets and is likely to result in fundamental adjustments to our television operations as a whole.
During the third quarter of 2025 our management began to implement the Plan, intended to support revenue growth and reduce expenses, primarily in our media operations.

We included the tax impact of Pillar 2 in the income tax for the three- and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026, based on the rules effective for that period, and continues to evaluate the impact of the SbS guidance on future periods.
We have analyzed the impact of these changes, noting that the main tax law changes that are expected to impact us in 2026 are related to depreciation and Section 163(j) interest expense limitation.
We will not take bonus depreciation in 2026 since, given our tax position, the impact on this is nil.
Regarding the Section 163(j) limitation, we believe that this will result in less taxable income to us.
We will recognize accrued interest and penalties related to unrecognized tax benefits in income tax expense.
We also provide digital marketing services for businesses targeting Latino consumers.
We anticipate that these changes in viewer habits and preferences, and in the broadcast industry as a whole, will persist at least for the foreseeable future and possibly permanently.

Additionally, we have previously noted a trend for advertising to move increasingly from traditional media, such as television and radio, to new media, such as digital media, and we expect this trend will also continue at least for the foreseeable future and possibly permanently.
No assurances can be given that these or other strategies will be successful in meeting the changes and challenges we face.
Among other things, this has led to lower margins in the products and services we sell, which we anticipate will persist for at least the foreseeable future and possibly permanently.
We expect this trend to continue and possibly accelerate.
No assurances can be given that the strategies we have pursued and investments we have made, and those we may pursue or make in the future, will be successful.

For at least the next twelve months, we expect to fund our working capital requirements, capital expenditures and payments of principal and interest on outstanding indebtedness, with cash on hand and cash flows from operations.
We expect to have positive cash flow from operating activities for the full year 2026.
We anticipate that our capital expenditures will be approximately $10 million during the full year 2026.
The amount of our anticipated capital expenditures may change based on future changes in business plans and our financial condition and general economic conditions.
We expect to fund capital expenditures with cash on hand and net cash flow from operations.

In the U.S., we provide video, audio and digital marketing services to local and national advertisers through a portfolio of television and radio stations and digital advertising services that target Latino audiences.
